verdicts.decision_note: The client requires review and a stamped deliverable; the administrative fee and turnaround are correctly excluded from the Event.
The target-specific response confirms that a stamped concurrence letter without redline drawings is an acceptable artifact presentation method.
The client explicitly defines two acceptable presentation methods for the stamped concurrence artifact and its confirmation purpose.
After the client delegates the choice, the freelancer selects the cover-letter and stamped-Word-file presentation method.
The client establishes that the concurrence letter must carry the PE stamp and signature; replacing the selected method leaves no conflicting top-level key.
First concrete failure: the reviewed concurrence letter was missing its required PE stamp.
Target-specific post-failure implementation claim: the freelancer reports returning the letter with its stamp.
First concrete verification: downstream client feedback explicitly confirms that the stamped concurrence note was good; the separate schematic-callout issue does not negate that result.
